findings: Independent read-only review confirmed that all request-declared artifacts were readable and every observed SHA-256 matched its live Controller binding.

Problem fit passes. H-CATI targets both accepted causal chains without changing the accepted Problem, residual Necessity envelope, RCA, or RMC identity: hereditary finite-area outcome state addresses contact-state aliasing, while the constraint-internalized scan-or-withdraw relation addresses intended/applied-action decoupling.

Method fit is not closed because the CONSTRAINED disposition is unsupported. The accepted envelope does not scientifically force a generalized-Maxwell/LuGre physical representation, and current Evidence neither establishes that this family contains the admitted contact-outcome relation nor eliminates structured-learned and physical-residual mechanisms. Absence of an already demonstrated physical-model residual is not evidence that the residual is absent. The prior accepted return explicitly required preservation of the UNDERCONSTRAINED P/L/H competition, and the cross-cycle history contains viable P, L, and H Candidates with no retirement or rejection evidence.

The strongest-simple-rival rule is applied asymmetrically. H-CATI is allowed to survive with physical-family containment as a fatal untested assumption, while learned and hybrid routes are discarded because their advantage is untested. All three are hypotheses under current Evidence. Simplicity can prioritize the physical route for testing, but cannot make it the only surviving Candidate unless a real Target constraint independently excludes the alternatives.

Calibration-out authority is not yet defensible for abrupt in-envelope changes. The online hard constraints use the contracted active set Theta_k. If the true contact jumps within Theta_env but outside the assumed drift set, Theta_k can cease to contain it before an inconsistent observation triggers reset; a nonempty but stale intersection can therefore authorize a scan action using relaxed margins. Saying that every member of Theta_k constrains action does not preserve independently valid envelope authority when the true member is outside Theta_k. The method must either use a certified containing envelope during the adapting state until re-entry is audited, or restrict its claim to precisely detectable drift-bounded changes with bounded detection latency.

The Method is unusually concrete and largely paper-level: its representation, action class, adaptation, horizon, energy state, robust selection, publication, and withdrawal semantics are explicit, and solver identity is correctly demoted. However, generalized-Maxwell plus LuGre state, fixed-facet geometry, and RTI-SQP remain hypotheses or realizations rather than Evidence-determined necessities; they cannot be used to close the scientific solution space.

The revised ACADEMIC_BRIDGE discovery provenance is now credible in the bound Evidence Cards: Q0104 supports VES/SPO discovery for RMC1 and Q0105 supports Predict-then-Calibrate discovery for RMC2. Nevertheless, same_field_mechanisms and cross_domain_structural_isomorphisms are empty, while the packet simultaneously cites positive partial Source mechanisms and declares NO_CREDIBLE_SOURCE_FOUND. The packet must record the discovered mechanisms and their intervention-level PASS/FAIL boundaries, or consistently classify them as Evidence-informed Target derivations without implying complete Source transfer.

The Candidate origin chain now binds both representation and total-action derivations, and its history, action-class, multistep, energy, and deadline predictions are substantially separated. But no formal killer concept discriminates the selected physical-only representation against the structured-learned and hybrid mechanisms used to justify the CONSTRAINED decision. PR-R12-P-ADAPT compares mainly against fixed conservative control rather than a credible bounded-adaptation rival, so it cannot establish necessity of the selected drift/reset set-membership mechanism.

Early Target Intervention Novelty is not closed at intervention level. The aggregate PARTIALLY_COVERED/RESTRUCTURED_DELTA narrative does not separately map the closest adaptive/passivity-aware MPVIC evidence xlNjdqnC2fMJ, learned MPVIC imoj6X2imAgJ, scalar identified-contact optimizer j4KJ1EdUyYAJ, and finite-area predefined-impedance MPC ZDySGaNsMn8J by changed variable or relation, direction, causal position, activation condition, and demonstrated prior effect. In particular, xlNjdqnC2fMJ is called a closest structural prior in supplemental material but is absent from the Candidate novelty closure and evidence refs.

Scientific strength therefore remains conditional rather than closed. H-CATI is implementable, analyzable, and potentially strong, but its unique selection, calibration-out hard-authority semantics, physical-versus-learned discriminator, and closest-prior separation are not ready for Principle Test Design. No accepted upstream premise is contradicted, so RCA_CONFLICT is not warranted.
